chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Abdullah, from Ziyad al-Qandi, from Abd al-Rahim al-Qasir, who said:

I entered upon Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) and said, 'May I be sacrificed for you, I have invented a supplication.' He (peace be upon him) said, 'Leave me from your invention. When a matter befalls you, turn urgently to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and pray two Rak'at, gifting them to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family).' I said, 'How should I do it?' He (peace be upon him) said, 'You perform Ghusl and pray two Rak'at, opening them with the opening of the obligatory prayer, and performing the Tashahhud of the obligatory prayer.'

So when you finish the Tashahhud and offer Salam, say: 'O Allah, You are As-Salam (the Peace), and from You is As-Salam, and to You returns As-Salam. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the Progeny of Muhammad, and convey to the soul of Muhammad from me the Salam, and to the souls of the truthful Imams my Salam, and return to me the Salam from them, and the Salam be upon them and the Mercy of Allah and His Blessings.'

O Allah, indeed these two Rak'at are a gift from me to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), so reward me for them what I hoped for and awaited in You and in Your Messenger, O Guardian of the Believers!
Then prostrate and say: 'O Living, O Eternal, O Living Who does not die, O Living, there is no god except You, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor, O Most Merciful of the merciful,' forty times.

Then place your right cheek and say it forty times. Then place your left cheek and say it forty times. Then raise your head and extend your hand and say it forty times. Then return your hand to your neck and rest on your index finger and say that forty times.

Then take your beard with your left hand and weep or wail and say: 'O Muhammad, O Messenger of Allah, I complain to Allah and to you of my need, and to the People of your Household, the rightly guided, of my need, and through you I turn to Allah regarding my need.'
Then prostrate and say: 'O Allah, O Allah,' until your breath is cut off, 'Send blessings upon Muhammad and the Progeny of Muhammad, and do such and such for me.'
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'So I am the guarantor upon Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, that he will not depart until his need is fulfilled.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ritual and supplication for fulfilling personal needs according to Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* details the *Salat al-Hajah*, a ritual prayer where two Rak'ats are offered as a gift to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) to facilitate the fulfillment of needs. The Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) guarantees success, emphasizing the spiritual mechanism of connecting through the Prophet's intercession and the repetitive invocation of 'Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyum' to invoke divine presence. This practice underscores the Shia theological emphasis on the closeness of the Ahl al-Bayt as mediators of divine grace and the efficacy of specific devotional acts in overcoming worldly trials.
